reason: No proposal has fresh AC measurements. The supplied battery scores are noisy and do not establish a winner. Test first the low-scope full-tile code changes that preserve the transpose, tile, and FP32 update order; the n=512 two-step path is promising to test but has added register-pressure risk. Next test loop and region changes that preserve the same arithmetic, then layout or packing changes with more memory traffic, and finally the scalar loop-order proposal that gives up SME MOPA. This orders hypotheses by expected information and correctness risk, not by claimed speed.
